title: Freshness
description: Liveness/staleness indicator carried on cluster + topology + slice views. Source of truth: composed from libp2p swarm liveness signals + slice timestamps (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

state.description: Liveness bucket. live = fresh signal; stale = past freshness window; offline = no signal; cached_offline_until_reconnect = served from cache awaiting reconnect; unverifiable = signal received but signature/freshness cannot be checked; all_offline = entire device set is offline.

staleSinceMs.description: Milliseconds since the last fresh signal, when state != live.
